title: TS-38 Transcript migration tool
description:
## Slice 2 ticket 38 of 40, phase notes: paths use `conversation/` (the workspace as it is on develop). Design source: `git show origin/docs/typescript-control-plane:docs/TYPESCRIPT_CONTROL_PLANE.md` (section 8, row 38); read sections 0.3, 2, 3 and 6 as needed. Read AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING_AGENT.md first. Never read or write `project/`; use `kbs` only.

## Goal
Build bin/migrate-transcripts.ts with copy, latest-turns, delta and verify phases as in section 2.7, idempotent, with MIGRATED# markers.

## Kind
prototype-first: a library API in this ticket is uncertain. A Sonnet agent must FIRST produce verified, runnable code for it (see Prototype section), paste it into this ticket as a comment, and ONLY THEN is the ticket completed with that code verbatim. A Haiku implementer must not start the build part until that comment exists; if it is missing, stop and report.

## Branch and commit
```text
git fetch origin
git switch -c ts/38-transcript-migration-tool origin/develop
...work, then...
git add <only the files listed under Files>
git commit -m "feat(conversation): transcript migration tool

Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>"
git push -u origin ts/38-transcript-migration-tool
```
Do NOT open a pull request; the orchestrator opens it. Commit messages contain no emojis.

## Files to create or change
- `conversation/bin/migrate-transcripts.ts`
- `conversation/src/migration/copy.ts`
- `conversation/src/migration/latest-turns.ts`
- `conversation/src/migration/verify.ts`
- `conversation/features-support/steps/transcript-migration.steps.ts`
- `features/transcript_migration.feature`

## Exported interface and error behavior
Sub-commands `copy`, `latest-turns`, `delta`, `verify`, each with `--environment`. Copy: per channel and bot participant, claim a fence, replay old messages in seq order (human -> user entries; own bot -> assistant entries with a synthetic message provider openai model migrated stopReason stop zero usage; other bots -> attributed user entries); write the channel log with the ORIGINAL seq, message_id, created_at; do not touch next_seq; requestId `migrate:<messageId>`; marker `MIGRATED#` per (channel, session).

General rules: TypeScript ESM, `.ts` import suffixes as in conversation/src/storage/; tabs for indentation as in existing files; long clear names; no line comments; TSDoc on exported symbols; no emojis. Each Python exception class used by a ported function becomes an exported `Error` subclass with the same name and the same message text. Failures are thrown, never returned as magic values, unless the Python returned them.

## Prototype (must be done and pasted before the build)
A Sonnet agent proves how to write a synthetic assistant entry and attributed user entries into a Pi session with explicit entry metadata (requestId idempotence on rerun) and pastes the code into the ticket.

## Behavior spec (Gherkin, ported unchanged)
No existing feature is ported by this ticket. Behavior is checked by the vitest or live check named under Verify.

New feature files (write FIRST, before any code): features/transcript_migration.feature. Use only Given/When/Then that describe observable behavior; no internals.

Failing run first (required):
```text
1. Write or port the step file(s) and any new .feature file.
2. cd conversation && npx cucumber-js ../features/<feature>.feature   -> confirm the scenarios FAIL for the right reason (missing production code, not a typo in a step). Save the first failing summary line for the commit body.
3. Write the smallest production code that passes. Re-run until green.
```
Manifest: when EVERY scenario of a feature is covered by this ticket (not marked partial above), add `features/<name>.feature` to `features/ported-features.txt` and add `<name>` to the alternation in `python/behave.ini` `exclude_re` (the manifest vitest `conversation/test/ported-features-manifest.test.ts` fails if they disagree). For a partial feature leave the manifest alone; the ticket named in the note finishes it. To run a partial feature, pass the path and `--name '<scenario>'` to cucumber-js; if CLI paths do not override the config paths, stop and report.

## Dependencies (blocked-by)
- ticket 16 (chatticus-8787e9): Message admission and listing; provides what its Files section lists.
- ticket 17 (chatticus-27c8bf): Turn control record and turn routes; provides what its Files section lists.
- ticket 18 (chatticus-2ffc48): Prototype and build: turn executor core; provides what its Files section lists.

## Verify
```text
cd conversation && npm run typecheck && npm test && npx cucumber-js ../features/<each feature of this ticket>.feature
```
moto setup (copied from the `conversation` job in .github/workflows/ci.yml):
```text
python -m pip install "moto[server]==5.2.3"
nohup moto_server -p 5555 > moto.log 2>&1 &
for i in $(seq 1 30); do if (echo > /dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/5555) 2>/dev/null; then break; fi; sleep 1; done
export CHATTICUS_TEST_AWS_ENDPOINT=http://127.0.0.1:5555
```
Install once at the repo root: `npm ci`. Stop moto when done: `pkill -f "moto_server -p 5555"`.
If the ticket added a feature to the manifest also run `cd conversation && npx cucumber-js` (full manifest) and `cd python && behave` is NOT required for ported features, but run `cd python && black --check src ../features tests && ruff check src ../features tests` if you touched anything under python/ or features/steps/.
Final cleanup before pushing:
```text
git status
```
Make sure NO `.orig`, `.rej`, `node_modules`, `build/`, `dist/`, `moto.log`, `.venv` or other stray files are staged: `git diff --cached --name-only | grep -E '\.orig$|\.rej$|node_modules|(^|/)build/|(^|/)dist/|moto\.log|\.venv'` must print nothing.

## Stop rules
If anything in this ticket is wrong, ambiguous, impossible, or contradicted by the code you find (a Python line range does not match, a step has no Python match, a library API differs from what is written, a scenario cannot pass without changing its text), STOP and report to the orchestrator with the exact file, line and observation. Never improvise, never weaken or delete a scenario to make it pass, never add a fallback or a compatibility branch.

## Python to delete
No production Python is deleted by this ticket (the one big deletion is ticket 40). The only deletions allowed: the per-feature step file of each feature newly added to the manifest, because the manifest vitest requires it: nothing. Shared step files (control_plane_steps.py, capability_policy_steps.py, messaging_steps.py, organization_steps.py and the like) are never edited here; the last ticket that uses them leaves them for ticket 40.
right_now_summary: The transcript migration tool awaits the required prototype before implementation can begin.
